artifacts.description: Initial Engineering State built from the specification

constraints.basis: source: TIDUES0 Table 1-1 (700-800 V); adopted as AIPE preliminary range
constraints.description: Operating input DC voltage 700 V to 800 V (nominal 800 V); 800 V also the design point for device stress.

constraints.basis: assumption (AIPE preliminary range; TI covers 250-500 V with EPS)
constraints.description: Operating output DC voltage 350 V to 450 V around the 400 V nominal; wider range requires EPS/DPS modulation study.
10 kW continuous at nominal voltages in both power-flow directions; derated power at the range corners to be established by simulation.

constraints.basis: assumption informed by source: TIDUES0 Table 1-1 (98.0 % full load, 98.8 % peak measured by TI)
constraints.description: Full-load efficiency target >= 97.5 % and peak >= 98.5 % at nominal voltages.

constraints.basis: assumption (common industrial derating practice; not a standard citation)
constraints.description: Semiconductor DC-bus voltage utilisation <= 70 % of VDS rating at the maximum bus voltage (1200 V class on the 800 V bus, >= 650 V class on the 400 V bus with overshoot margin).
Design maximum junction temperature 125 degC at 40 degC ambient and rated power; absolute maximum per datasheet (150-175 degC) never reached under fault-free operation.

constraints.basis: assumption; source: TIDUES0 BOM (Payton transformer 5000 VDC)
constraints.description: Transformer and all primary-to-secondary barriers rated for reinforced isolation of an 800 V DC system; transformer dielectric test >= 5 kV DC as in the reference design; creepage/clearance per IEC 60664-1 to be verified in the PCB stage.
Peak flux density <= 70 % of the core material's saturation flux density at 100 degC under worst-case volt-seconds.
Fixed 100 kHz switching frequency for the SPS baseline.
All eight switches must satisfy the ZVS current condition at the nominal operating point; light-load ZVS loss is reported, not required for the SPS baseline.

converter.description: Single-phase isolated bidirectional DAB; two full bridges, eight controlled switches.

environment.cooling: forced-air baseline; natural convection and liquid cooling evaluated as alternatives (assumption)
